title: 礼来如何成为万亿美元药企？GLP-1热潮下的崛起与挑战
speaker: Bloomberg

segments.en: The GLP-1 boom has changed everything about Lilly.
Ten years ago, it had a market cap of about $100 billion today, that's over a trillion dollars.
segments.zh: 十年前市值约1000亿美元，如今已超万亿。

segments.en: Lilly went from a sort of sleepy Midwest drug maker into a trillion dollar pharmaceutical company, and the most valuable healthcare company in the world.
segments.zh: 礼来从中西部不起眼的药企，成长为全球最具价值的医疗公司。

segments.en: You really rarely even hear about a trillion dollar healthcare company, the challenge now is what is the next chapter after Zepound and Muncharo.
segments.zh: 万亿级医疗公司极为罕见，挑战在于Zepbound和Mounjaro之后的下一个篇章。

segments.en: GLP-1s are the biggest story in healthcare, and no single company has benefited more than Eli Lilly.
segments.zh: GLP-1是医疗界最大热点，礼来受益最多。

segments.en: We're a medicine company and we should make medicines for the biggest problems in healthcare.
segments.zh: 我们是制药公司，应针对医疗最大难题研发药物。

segments.en: The traditional challenge for pharmaceutical companies is maintaining success.
segments.zh: 药企的传统挑战在于如何持续成功。

segments.en: Drugs have a shelf life, their patents expire, competition emerges, their generic formulations of medication.
segments.zh: 药物有生命周期，专利到期，竞争出现，仿制药上市。

segments.en: Eli Lilly has had examples of this. It was dominating the market for depression medication with Prozac.
segments.zh: 礼来曾凭百忧解主导抗抑郁药市场。

segments.en: Eli Lilly right now almost presents more as like a technology company with the kind of culture and hours that you might see in Silicon Valley and not Indianapolis.
segments.zh: 如今礼来更像科技公司，文化和工作时长堪比硅谷，而非印第安纳波利斯。

segments.en: There are many people who benefit not enough. Zepound and products like that can change lives of about 40% of US adults who have obesity
segments.zh: 许多人受益不足。Zepound这类产品可以改变约40%的美国肥胖成年人的生活。

segments.en: overweight. Insurance coverage has really lagged behind the need only around a dozen or so states right now that currently cover the drugs through Medicaid.
segments.zh: 保险覆盖远落后于需求，目前只有十几个州通过Medicaid覆盖这些药物。
